correctness.rationale: The radical-square-zero multiplication gives the exact coefficient equation at every arrow. For fixed diagonal pairs, each arrow contributes q solutions unless its endpoint colors coincide, in which case it contributes q^2 for zero target and 0 for nonzero target. Since distinct arrows have independent variables, the graph coloring product is exact. Expanding by edge subsets yields the full multivariate Tutte evaluation. The coloring obstruction is necessary and sufficient for single commutators, and concatenating r pairs of vertex labels gives both necessary and sufficient q^(2r)-coloring criteria for expressing arbitrary target as r commutators, including empty-arrow boundary. All tests in verify.py pass; their finite scope is stated.

value.rationale: The exact target-support criterion and the chromatic-number equality for additive commutator width are intrinsic nontrivial properties, unbounded over a fixed finite field. The full fiber polynomial refines the previously known commuting probability and enables exact membership and multiplicity questions on any loopless quiver with arbitrary arrow multiplicities. Width is a sharp graph obstruction, not a routine single-graph enumeration. The dependence on all nonzero-support patterns and the arbitrary-number-of-vertices classification motivates the precise invariant and its use in further work on higher radical powers.
